# systeam_lifecycle_watch (Resource)

Tracks the lifecycle / end-of-life of an external resource (e.g. an AI model, the 'Technology Watch' feature) and notifies at 90/30/7-day thresholds and on new releases.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (Number) The organization this watch belongs to.
- `vendor` (String) The vendor being watched (e.g. 'openai', 'anthropic').

### Optional

- `channel_ids` (Set of Number) Notification channels to alert. Write-only: the API does not return these on read.
- `notify_30d` (Boolean) Notify 30 days before end-of-life.
- `notify_7d` (Boolean) Notify 7 days before end-of-life.
- `notify_90d` (Boolean) Notify 90 days before end-of-life.
- `notify_on_new` (Boolean) Notify when a new release/version appears.
- `platform` (String) Optional platform qualifier (part of the watch's identity).
- `resource_id` (String) Optional specific resource id to watch (part of the watch's identity).
- `resource_type` (String) The kind of resource being watched (default 'ai_model').

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The unique identifier of the watch.
